title: Finite-presentation envelope used in the final assembly
statement:
Let $S$ be a quasi-compact, quasi-separated scheme and let $f:X\to S$ be a separated morphism of finite type. Using the explicit pair $\mathsf{Env}_{\mathrm{fp}}(X/S)$ of [def-nagata-finite-type-closed-in-fp], define

$$
\mathsf E_f=(X_f^{\mathrm{fp}},i_f^{\mathrm{fp}})
=\mathsf{Env}_{\mathrm{fp}}(X/S).
$$

Here $X_f^{\mathrm{fp}}$ retains the structure morphism to $S$ of the selected approximation stage, and $i_f^{\mathrm{fp}}:X\to X_f^{\mathrm{fp}}$ is the second component of that same pair.
